Items to be checked:
Installation Manual
Before checking the items listed below, carefully read the manufacturers installation instructions
Confirm that the installation has been completed as per the instructions.
Manufacturers installation instructions have been carried out in an acceptable manner
General
For all transformer/rectifier installations the following points must be checked out. (Applicable items only)
Equipment located as per drawings
All pieces of equipment properly located and assembled as per details by manufacturer
All major pieces of equipment fastened to floor (transformer(s), rectifier(s), control panel(s), cooling equipment)
Transformer(s)
Check transformer(s) for oil leaks
All protection and control devices mounted and wired
All pieces of equipment removed for shipment, reattached
Water cooling pipes, valves and strainers properly installed and flushed
Transformer(s) grounded in two (2) places
Oil spill collection sump system inspected for size, drain and flame arrestor gravel
Check silicagel in oil breathers.  Colour  must be blue
Rectifier(s)
All protection and control devices mounted and wired
All pieces of equipment removed for shipment, reattached
Water cooling pipes, valves and strainers must be insulated and flushed.  Note:  These connections must be insulated electrically (PVC flange etc)
Rectifier grounded as per manufacturers requirements
Interconnections
The following interconnections must be checked:
HV connection(s) to transformer(s) and to HV circuit breaker(s)

Bus bar connections to transformer(s) and rectifier(s)
Note:  Do not connect bus bars to electrolyzers until the manufacturer’s checkout person has finished his/her check out.
All interwiring between transformer/rectifier system(s) and plant control system (PCS)
All terminations (wiring) retorqued
All interwiring between transformer/rectifier and HV circuit breaker
Transformer/Rectifier Circuit Breaker Switch Panel
Circuit breaker switch panel mounted in control room
Circuit breaker switch panel wired to transformer/rectifier, PCS and circuit breaker as per drawings
Cooling Media
If the transformer(s) has been shipped less than full of oil, locate the oil drums shipped separately and stored in transformer/rectifier area.  Do not fill at this time.

If the rectifier(s) is cooled by a closed loop water system and if this system has been drained for shipping, locate the ethylene glycol solution containers shipped separately, and store in transformer/rectifier area.  Do not fill at this time.
Metering
Check DC CT correctly mounted and wired
